blocks.x: What Cloud, Edge & Platform changes for Retail & Consumer Banking: the processes we target, the controls we inherit, the platforms underneath, and the measured delta at every gate.

Retail banks fight on experience and cost per account: onboarding friction, service resolution and cross-sell precision decide share of wallet. The machinery underneath — decisioning, document intelligence, contact platforms — is where Dataq Software engineers advantage.

items: Branch, ATM and app estates carry fixed costs without unit telemetry; nobody can state cost per transaction by channel.
Account opening abandons at KYC and document stages; manual checks take days while fintechs approve in minutes. Drop-off concentrates exactly where policy risk is highest.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Cloud-Native & Legacy Modernization, SRE & Reliability Engineering, FinOps & Sustainable Computing from the Cloud, Edge & Platform Engineering tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Account opening and KYC, Payment disputes and exceptions, Contact-center resolution) on Dataq Forge and Dataq Twinverse. Governance inherits the sector frame — KYC/AML directives among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: When microseconds and uptime are the product: HPC, low-latency and always-on engineering.
The estate as designed system: landing zones, network fabric and workload placement by economics.
Retire the legacy tax: strangler-pattern modernization with measurable unit economics.
Per-channel cost telemetry with workload isolation (unit cost per transaction visible and falling)

blocks.caption: Regimes shaping this capability
rows: customer due diligence with periodic refresh duties
strong customer authentication with friction trade-offs
ICT risk, incident reporting, resilience testing and third-party oversight obligations with supervisory scrutiny

blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Banking & Financial Services level this capability reads as: unit cost per payment instrumented; commitment and workload isolation applied (processing unit cost down 25-40%). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

Delivery runs on one weekly rhythm for every program of this type. Weeks 1–2 measure and sign the baseline with your team; nothing builds against an unsigned number. Weeks 3–8 prove the pattern on deliberately bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — under a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked into runbooks, monitoring and enablement, closing with a measured delta against the baseline. Every gate is pass, stop or redirect, in writing.
